author: claude-opus-5-5
comparison: Rejected drawing squeezed a small ring head under the helmet with short bars as hair and a boxy body; it read as neither the reference's portrait nor a woman. The original is a head portrait: tall hard-hat dome with a large crown lamp, wide brim, long face and hair falling past the cheeks.
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px light/dark. Large headlamp on a tall dome, wide brim, a long face hanging below, hair locks falling from the brim ends and curling in; matches the reference layout at 48.
omissions: Shoulders (absent in the reference) and inner hair strands (no 8-unit room beside the face); the hair curls in rather than flipping out because the keyshape edge is at x=8.
human_reference: icon_set/references/human_ref/user.svg (head proportions); head portrait with no body, so no head/body contact applies.
